# Use existing access_token for simple_note from previous block and spotify_token for spotify

# 1) Parse existing note content
note_id = 3084
old_content = note_res['content']
print('old_content snippet:\n', old_content)

lines = [ln.rstrip() for ln in old_content.splitlines()]
release_todo_lines = [ln for ln in lines if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in ln]
release_filled_lines = [ln for ln in lines if 'RELEASED_AT' in ln and 'RELEASED_AT TODO' not in ln]
print('total lines', len(lines))
print('release filled lines', len(release_filled_lines))
print('release todo lines', len(release_todo_lines))
print('todo lines:', release_todo_lines)

# 2) Build release month/year map for spotify liked songs
# liked list from previous block may still exist in environment
print('liked songs count', len(liked))

from datetime import datetime

def month_year(date_str):
    # date_str like '2019-01-01T00:00:00'
    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(date_str.replace('Z',''))
    return dt.strftime('%m/%Y')

song_release = {}
for s in liked:
    song_id = s['song_id']
    details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
    rd = details.get('release_date')
    title = details.get('title')
    if rd:
        song_release[title] = month_year(rd)
    else:
        song_release[title] = None
print('song_release entries', len(song_release))
print('sample', list(song_release.items())[:5])

# 3) Determine replacements for TODO lines based on title parsing
import re

def parse_line_title_artist(line):
    # format: - {title} BY {artists} RELEASED_AT {value}
    m = re.match(r'^-\s*(.*?)\s+BY\s+(.*?)\s+RELEASED_AT\s+(.*)$', line)
    if not m:
        return None
    title = m.group(1).strip()
    artists = m.group(2).strip()
    released = m.group(3).strip()
    return title, artists, released

updates = []
new_content = old_content
for ln in release_todo_lines:
    parsed = parse_line_title_artist(ln)
    print('parsed', parsed)
    if not parsed:
        continue
    title, artists, released = parsed
    new_val = song_release.get(title)
    updates.append((title, artists, released, new_val))
    if new_val:
        # replace ONLY TODO token
        new_content = new_content.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f'RELEASED_AT {new_val}', 1)

print('planned updates:', updates)

# sanity checks
remaining_todos = [ln for ln in new_content.splitlines() if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in ln]
print('remaining todo lines after update:', len(remaining_todos))
print(remaining_todos)
